title: Maid-sama!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Misaki Ayuzawa, the first female student council president of a rowdy, mostly male high school, is known as a strict boy-hater. Secretly she works at a maid cafe to help pay off the debt her father left her mother and sister. Popular, gifted Takumi Usui discovers her secret, keeps it, and pursues her; they fall in love despite his aristocratic English family's objections, and eventually marry.
life_message: It holds up hard work, responsibility to family and a love that respects a strong partner.

content.note: Comic punching and kicking; Misaki is tied up by stalkers and fights them off (CSM on the anime).
Stalker and harassment scenes, resolved quickly (CSM).

Teen romance at the center, adult magazines among boys, suggestive poses, S&M jokes; maid-cafe setting as mild fan service (CSM 14+; Wikipedia reception on fan service). Kept restrained per ANN (Wikipedia).
Misaki overworks and neglects her health; family poverty from an absent father's debt (Wikipedia; CSM).
Takumi's persistent pursuit and catcalling by other boys; some critics read the romance as sexist (Wikipedia reception).
Maid-cafe work culture shown; no product focus (CSM).
